description.value: The Kitimat Museum & Archives (originally the Kitimat Centennial Museum, opened 1969) preserves and shares the natural, cultural, and Indigenous history of Kitimat and the Haisla Nation, and is rated the #1 Indoor Attraction in Kitimat. It offers permanent and rotating exhibitions, an archival collection, visual arts galleries, educational programs, and a gift shop, making it a substantial cultural stop for cyclists passing through the region. The museum is committed to amplifying Haisla voices and history, operating on unceded Haisla territory.
